Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

UDC655-225-8:68V616-12 IS I 11122 ( Part 3 ) -1984 




Indian Standard ( Reaffirmed 2001 ) 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
LETTER PRESS PRINTING PLATES AND EQUIPMENT 

PART 3 GALLEYS 



1. Scope — Specifies dimensions (thickness) and certain technical requirements for galleys. 

2. Definition — For the purposes of this standard, following definition shall apply. 

2.1 Ga//e/ — A flat, rectangular, three walled tray on which composed matter in the form of type, 
blocks, etc, is handled. 

3. Material — Galley shall be made from rust-resisting steel strip or from steel strip adequately treated 
to protect it against corrosion, or from any other suitable material. 

4. Thickness —The thickness of galleys shall be 1*20 ± 005 mm. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard is being issued in the following four parts: 
Part 1 Original printing plates 
Part 2 Flat metal duplicate plates 
Part 3 Galleys 
Part 4 Jobbing chases 

If necessary, further parts will be issued to cover other components. While preparing this 
standard, assistance has been derived from BS 4946 : Part 3 : 1973 'Specification for letter press 
printing plates and equipment: Part 3 Galleys' issued by the British Standards Institution. 



Adopted 28 November 1984
